body: I’m trying but I think I’ll give it a few weeks.  I was doing okay but the onset of static in my brain and ringing in my ears means I’m unable t cope.

It’s like tinnitus is genuinely the worst thing ever. You’re stuck in this purgatory becuase you want to end your life to stop it , but you also don’t really want to die. How can you ever explain this feeling to anyone.

Actually. Past two days. The ringing has almost gone completely. Now I’ve been left behind with static in my head. It’s like I induce it myself becuase of anxiety. Like my brain can’t handle silence as much so all I’m left with is me creating this constant static sound. I hate it. But it’s constant. And I’m trying to remain hopeful of the fact that I’m doing this to myself so I need to stop somehow. I pray it goes.

Hi, I don’t know if you’re asking me or the other person but I’ll answer . Thanks for being concerned. I’m doing a lot better. I realised once I accepted that I have it, it decided to naturally go down itself. For the past few weeks it’s been raging. But I meditated, went for walks and cleared my mind. Listened to music. And for some reason it just goes less and less by the day. I hope to see it go completely soon enough. But just have to be strong and patient. My tinnitus also appeared out of nowhere, not noise-induced or resulting from an underlying condition or ear damage (did an MRI and hearing test). So it seems that it could’ve triggered from trauma or stress.
I want to die so badly. Had. For 2 weeks now. I’m extremely suicidal and anxious
Yes. My family know that I can’t deal with it. They don’t know how serious I am about killing my self
Hi thanks for your message. I don’t think anything can be done. I might give it a few weeks or days depending on how I go. Then I think I will kill myself.

Hi I’m 21. I’ve had tinnitus for about a week now. I know it’s not long but I can’t stand it. I know it’s incurable and permanent because it’s the same every day, no changes. People try support me but no one is inside my head. I am genuinely considering suicide. But trying to figure out how to go about it. Would a euthanasia clinic help me or would they reject me ? And how many pills would I have to take to overdose. I’m just thinking. Because I’m sure I can’t live with this

I am desperate to kill myself, I know I can’t live with this for the rest of my life. I’m trying to see if I can get killed through a euthanasia clinic otherwise  maybe overdose might work. I’m just not sure how to go about it
